cleanup_unused_entities.name: Clean up unused entities
cleanup_unused_entities.description: Removes device tracker entities for clients the router no longer reports. Runs as a preview by default.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Leave on to list what would be removed without removing anything. Turn off to actually remove them.

reset_entities.name: Reset entities
reset_entities.description: Bulk-manage which entities this integration has enabled. Use it after enabling everything to see what your router offers, to clean up entities your model does not report, or to save and restore your own set. Runs as a preview by default and changes nothing until you turn Preview off.

entry_id.name: Router
entry_id.description: The router to act on. Defaults to your only router; required if more than one is configured.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: Report what would change without changing anything. Leave this on first, read the result, then run again with it off. The preview also lists the entity IDs you may want to put in Keep These Entities.

reset_to_default.name: Reset to defaults
reset_to_default.description: Return every entity to the state this integration ships. This is how to undo enabling everything. It also applies newer defaults to an installation set up before them. Off by default, so nothing happens until you choose something.

enable_populated.name: Enable what your router reports
enable_populated.description: Turn on every entity your router currently supplies a value for. Answers "show me what this device can actually do". Enables entities the defaults leave off, so expect a longer list than the defaults give.

disable_unavailable.name: Disable unavailable entities
disable_unavailable.description: Turn off entities currently showing Unavailable. Only affects entities that are already enabled.

disable_unknown.name: Disable unknown entities
disable_unknown.description: Turn off entities currently showing Unknown. Only affects entities that are already enabled.

include_ever_populated.name: Include entities that once had a value
include_ever_populated.description: By default the two Disable options skip entities that have reported a value on this router before, so you do not lose your 5G sensors because the connection has dropped to 4G today. Turn this on to disable those as well. Check the preview before you do.

preserve_user_customized.name: Keep entities you switched off
preserve_user_customized.description: Leave alone any entity you disabled yourself, so a reset does not turn it back on. There is no equivalent for entities you switched on - Home Assistant does not record who enabled an entity - so use Keep These Entities for those.

exclude_entities.name: Keep these entities
exclude_entities.description: Entities to leave exactly as they are, whatever else this action does. Use it to carry a few favourites through a reset. Run the preview first and copy the ones you want to keep from its list.

save_snapshot.name: Save current set
save_snapshot.description: Record which entities are enabled right now as your own set, so you can return to it later with Restore Saved Set. Cannot be combined with any option that changes things - set your entities up first, then save. While Preview Only is on, nothing is written and the result reports "saved false".

restore_snapshot.name: Restore saved set
restore_snapshot.description: Return to the set you saved earlier, instead of this integration's defaults. Entities added by a later update are not in your saved set and keep their normal default.
